question: Does Fzd4 signaling recruit general-capillary cells into regenerative renewal after injury?

unit: independent animal/preparation with resolved round and capillary context
primary_outcome: traced capillary descendant yield per initial viable labeled population
execution_gate: Identify eligible data and freeze remaining assay-specific comparisons, margins, models and validation before new outcomes are inspected.
biological_hypothesis: Fzd4 contributes to injury-induced gCap recruitment into a regenerative state that supplies renewed gCap and aerocyte descendants.
mechanistic_prediction: Verified perturbation changes regenerative-state entry before traced descendant production, with an effect distinguishable from generalized endothelial loss.
measurement_checks_role: Eligibility and rival checks support the biological test; marker disagreement or score robustness is not the research endpoint.
refinement: Focus on Fzd4-dependent capillary vascular integrity permitting later repopulation, versus selective entry or aerocyte production. These remain proposed mechanisms. Preserve separate original lineage outputs.
expression_lead_status: Original pooled association retired as affirmative renewal evidence; independent within-condition cycling association inconsistent and underpowered.
